title: I know my Redeemer lives
lyrics: Verse 1:
Who told the sun where to stand in the morning?
Who told the ocean you can only come this far?
Who showed the moon where to hide 'til evening?
Whose words alone can catch a falling star?
Chorus 1:
I [G]know my Re[C]dee[G/C]mer [D]lives
I [C]know my Re[B7]deemer [C]lives
All of [C]creation testi[D]fy
This [B7]life with[B7/D#]in me [Em]cries
[D]I [C]know my Re[D]deemer [G]lives
Verse 2:
The very same God that spins things in orbit
Runs to the weary, the worn and the weak
And the same gentle hands that hold me when I'm broken
They conquered death to bring me victory
Bridge 1:
He lives to take away my sin
And He lives forever I proclaim
That the payment for my sin was the precious life He gave
But now He's alive and there's an empty grave
